title: invocation-prober-and-threshold-tuner-introduce-phase-sampling-and-alert-autocalibrate
author: Priya Nair
description:
Motivation: Long-tail invocation latency and token-cost spikes are often caused by phase-localized regressions (initialization, kv-warm, model-emit/stream). Existing per-request metrics obscure phase structure because they aggregate end-to-end. This PR introduces a low-overhead "invocation prober" that periodically samples per-invocation phase timings and emits a compact phase-entropy gauge to our telemetry pipeline, plus a threshold-tuner service that suggests per-route alert thresholds based on historical phase percentiles and cost impact.

What this PR does (summary):
- Adds an invocation prober that attaches lightweight phase markers to a subset of invocations and emits phase-duration histograms and a computed phase-entropy gauge (how much time distribution across phases varies).
- Enriches OTLP spans with phase attributes (phase.start, phase.end, phase.name) for sampled spans and adds token-phase labels for streaming responses.
- Exposes new Prometheus metrics (invocation_phase_entropy, invocation_phase_pXX, invocation_phase_sample_rate) and a minimal aggregator that computes per-route percentile baselines used by the threshold-tuner.
- Adds a threshold-tuner microservice that computes adaptive alert bands per-route using a cost-weighted blend of p90/p95/p99 and suggests alert hysteresis values. The tuner can operate in passive-suggest mode (UI only) or active-suggest where it proposes changes to managed alert policies.
- Adds dashboards and panels under Observability -> Invocation Phase Insights (phase timeline heatmap, entropy sparkline, baseline bands) and a playbook for investigating high-phase-entropy incidents.
- Implements guardrails: probe sampling is bounded by tenant-configurable rate limits and prober includes a CPU/latency backoff to avoid perturbing hot paths.

Why this approach: Aggregates hide phase-specific regressions and make it hard to tune alerts without excessive noise. Phase-entropy provides a compact indicator that highlights when distribution of time across phases shifts (e.g., backend coldstart vs. slow kernel). The threshold-tuner reduces manual alert churn by recommending data-driven hysteresis tuned to cost impact.

Checklist: 
- [x] Prober core implementation (go): telemetry/prober.go, prober/worker.go
- [x] OTLP span enrichment and attribute docs: tracing/attrs.md
- [x] Prometheus metric exports and targets: metrics/invocation_phase_exporter.go
- [x] Threshold-tuner service (py): alerts/threshold_tuner.py, alerts/runner.py
- [x] Dashboard JSON and panels: observability/dashboards/invocation_phase_insights.json
- [x] Unit tests + integration e2e harness: prober_test.go, threshold_tuner_test.py, e2e/prober_harness.sh
- [x] Docs (Console playbook + runbook): docs/observability/invocation_phase_playbook.md
- [x] Backoff/guardrail implementation and feature flag: config/flags.yaml

Performance notes: The prober opportunistically samples ~0.5% of invocations by default (configurable) and adds ~120 bytes of span attribute payload for sampled requests. Benchmarks run in the PR show median overhead <0.25ms on hot paths at 0.5% sampling. Aggregation for entropy uses reservoir sketches to keep memory bounded.

Migration notes: No breaking API changes. New metrics are additive. Admins can toggle the prober via the observability toggle in Console or set sampling to 0 to disable. Threshold suggestions are opt-in before they modify alert policies.

Related work: This complements existing token-cost rollups and span-synthesis work (see ENG-2053, ENG-2310). Linear tickets included in linked_linear.

Testing: unit tests for metric exporters and tuner algorithm, local e2e harness that replays synthetic invocations with deterministic phase patterns, and a staged rollout in dev->staging->prod with gradual sampling increase.

Follow-ups planned: integrate tuner suggestions into rollout automation (A/B change), add tenant-aware cost simulation to the tuner, and add per-model phase profiles to the model registry for offline analysis.

merge_details: Merged by squash on 2026-03-05 by Priya Nair. Commit message consolidated prober + threshold-tuner. Release note added to CHANGELOG under Observability section.
release_notes: Add Invocation Prober (phase sampling + entropy gauge) and Threshold Tuner (adaptive alert suggestions). New metrics: invocation_phase_entropy, invocation_phase_pXX, invocation_phase_sample_rate. Dashboards: Invocation Phase Insights. Opt-in threshold automation; prober sampling is configurable and disabled by default.
notes_for_oncall: If phase-entropy spikes appear after rollout, first toggle prober sampling to 0 for the affected tenant via Console feature flag. Use the playbook (docs/observability/invocation_phase_playbook.md) to correlate entropy spikes with kernel-queue/gpu-warm metrics. Threshold-tuner suggestions are non-destructive unless applied explicitly.
